slide1.title:
PawDex began with
Eve's treatment journey
slide1.desc:
When 10-year-old Eve was in treatment, we needed
trustworthy information and consistent records.

slide2.title:
Get AI analysis from
symptoms or a photo
slide2.desc:
From the symptoms you describe to a single photo, we surface
likely concerns and tailored care guides.

slide3.title:
Let today's notes
become tomorrow's hints
slide3.desc:
Log symptoms, visits, daily life, meds, and prevention —
see them all at a glance on the timeline and calendar.

slide4.title:
The more you log,
the clearer the trends
slide4.desc:
Track weight, water, meals, fluids, and bathroom logs,
then spot the trends at a glance on charts.

slide5.title:
Fast on the essentials,
transparent to the source
slide5.desc:
We translate and summarize relevant papers for easy reading,
and you can always check the original.

slide6.title:
In urgent moments,
less wandering
slide6.desc:
Quickly find 24-hour hospitals on the map
and head out right away.
